description: Controlled vocabulary for Trestle API entities and fields. Use this for consistent field naming in AI-generated code and documentation.

Phone.description: A phone number record with carrier, line type, and subscriber metadata.

Person.description: An individual identified as a phone owner or address resident.

Location.description: A physical address record with validation and geolocation data.

activity_score.meaning: Phone line activity likelihood. 70+ = high confidence connected. 30- = high confidence disconnected/inactive. 50 = insufficient data.

contact_grade.meaning: Lead contactability grade. A = high quality/contactable. F = bad lead, deprioritize.

is_valid.meaning: True if the phone number (or email/address depending on context) is structurally valid. In Decision Signals: phone = valid and carrier-associated; address = validated to at least street level; email = syntactically valid; IP = valid and publicly routable.

name_match.meaning: True if the provided name matches the name on record for the phone/email/address. Null if no name data was found.

trust_score.meaning: IP Trust Score. Higher = more legitimate. Factors in VPN/proxy usage, network type, geographic signals.

ip_distance_to_address.meaning: Approximate distance between the user's IP location and the provided physical address. NULL if IP location confidence is low.

delivery_point.meaning: The USPS delivery point type for the address.

location_type.meaning: The geographic granularity of a location record.

lat_long.accuracy.meaning: The precision level of the lat/long coordinates.

phone_status.meaning: Live-call outcome for a dialed phone number. Used in Phone Feedback API.

phone_right_party_contact.meaning: Whether the live call confirmed the number belongs to the intended person.

input_set.meaning: Prefix grouping one party's inputs in a single request, e.g. primary.name, primary.phone, secondary.address.city. Each submitted input returns a <set>_<input>_checks block (e.g. secondary_phone_checks); blocks for inputs not sent are null. Typical pairings: home/work, billing/shipping, business/principal. Only one ip_address is accepted per request.

transaction_id.meaning: Required caller-supplied correlation ID for the transaction being checked.

transaction_time.meaning: Required UTC timestamp of the transaction, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or ISO 8601. Positive UTC offsets and compact forms (YYYYMMDDTHHMM) are rejected.

identity_score.meaning: Composite trust score across phone, address, email, and IP checks. 50 = neutral baseline; 80+ = high trust; under 30 = multiple risk signals. Never null. A name alone returns 50; a partial address adds no weight.

address_match.meaning: How closely the phone's registered location matches the input address, from exact to none.

address_checks.type.meaning: Address type in Decision Signals address checks. Spaced values; not the same field or values as delivery_point (SingleUnit, MultiUnit, ...). Null unless is_valid is true.

is_forwarder.meaning: True if the address is a known freight-forwarding or reshipping location. Null unless the address is valid.

is_disposable.meaning: True if the email domain is a known disposable or temporary provider.

email_age_score.meaning: How established an email address is. 100 = oldest and most trusted.

email_domain_creation_days.meaning: Days since the email domain was first registered (whois). Null when the domain is not found or the lookup times out.

connection_type.meaning: Network type of an IP address. Open list; new values may appear.

distance_from_*.meaning: Distance between two inputs. Fields: secondary_address_checks.distance_from_primary_address, and ip_address_checks.distance_from_primary_address / distance_from_secondary_address / distance_from_primary_phone / distance_from_secondary_phone. Null when unavailable; secondary_address_checks.distance_from_primary_address is omitted when null.

common_warnings.Missing Input: A required or recommended field was not provided.
common_warnings.Invalid Phone: The phone number is not a valid phone number.
common_warnings.Invalid Address: The address could not be validated.
common_warnings.Invalid Email: The email address is not valid.
common_warnings.Free Email Service Provider: The email domain is a free provider (e.g., gmail.com).
common_warnings.Disposable Email: The email appears to be from a disposable email service.
common_warnings.Undeliverable Email: The email address cannot receive mail.
common_warnings.International number. Not authorized: The phone number is international and the key is not authorized for international lookups.
common_warnings.Lead is a Litigator. Must not be contact: The phone subscriber is a known TCPA litigator.
common_warnings.Partial Address: Only partial address inputs were provided (postal code, or city and state without a street).
common_warnings.Freight Forwarder: The address is a known freight-forwarding or reshipping location.
common_warnings.Role Based Email: The email is a role-based address, for example info@ or admin@.
common_warnings.Proxy detected: The IP address is associated with a proxy, VPN, or anonymizing service.

warning_format_notes.Decision Signals API: Warnings from every check are aggregated into the root warnings array and prefixed by component, e.g. "Primary Phone: Invalid Phone", "Secondary Email: Disposable Email", "IP: Proxy detected". Errors are aggregated into a root errors array of strings, not an error object.
